name: Berenice Jonguitud
bio: Young singer and actress from Tuxpan, Veracruz. She won the Municipal Singing Contest in Tuxpan in 2021, and collaborated in the TV series "Pinches Momias".
place: Tuxpan de Rodríguez Cano, Veracruz, México
